sections.title: Recorded agreement
sections.note: Working schedule only. Attach signed terms, verify export permissions and insurance, and obtain registrar approval before dispatch.

sections.title: Objects
sections.sql: select o.code,o.name,li.export_decision,li.reviewed_by,li.permit_ref from loan_items li join objects o on o.id=li.object_id where loan_id=$1 order by o.code

sections.title: Object
sections.sql: select code,name,description,maker from objects where id=$1

sections.title: Inspections
sections.sql: select checked_on,checked_by,grade,findings,next_review from conditions where object_id=$1 order by checked_on desc

sections.title: Receipt and decision
sections.note: Does not itself transfer title. Attach the signed deed and follow the museum acquisition policy.
sections.sql: select a.code,a.name,a.received_on,a.method,a.decision,a.title_evidence,p.name as source from accessions a left join people p on p.id=a.source_id where a.id=$1

sections.title: Object list
sections.sql: select code,name,description from objects where accession_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Recorded moves
sections.sql: select m.moved_at,f.name as from_location,t.name as to_location,m.moved_by,m.authorised_by,m.reason from movements m left join locations f on f.id=m.from_location_id join locations t on t.id=m.to_location_id where m.object_id=$1 order by moved_at
